allow: PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3825 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c.OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; "stopped PID $_" } } else { "no listener on 3825" })

PowerShell($tools = 'docker','wsl','python','python3','node','deno','bash','git'; foreach \($t in $tools\) { $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "{0,-8} -> {1}" -f $t, $c.Source } else { "{0,-8} -> \(not found\)" -f $t } })
